upsell.title: Adobe-trusted signatures
upsell.devSeal: This deployment seals completed envelopes with a demo certificate, so Adobe Acrobat reports the signatures as untrusted.
upsell.pitch: With OpenFilz Cloud Signing, envelopes are sealed with OpenFilz's Adobe-approved (AATL) certificate — signatures show as valid in Acrobat, for €1 per user per month. Only a document hash ever leaves your deployment.
upsell.byoc: Prefer your own identity? Bring your own AATL certificate (PKCS#12 file or Azure Key Vault HSM) — the AATL Onboarding Pack guides you from purchase to first sealed PDF.

ee.pitch: As an Enterprise customer, OpenFilz Cloud Signing is available as an option on your subscription (+€1 per user per month): envelopes are sealed with OpenFilz's Adobe-approved (AATL) certificate and signatures show as valid in Acrobat. Only a document hash ever leaves your deployment.

discoverEe.title: Discover OpenFilz Enterprise
discoverEe.pitch: You are running the open-source Community Edition. OpenFilz Enterprise adds private per-user spaces, document sharing & permissions, comments & mentions, teams, analytics, webhooks & integrations, document scanning with OCR, antivirus, backups and PDF/A archiving with trusted e-signatures.

aiMaintenance.title: AI maintenance
aiMaintenance.description: Jobs that keep the AI features in step with the library. They run on the server in the background: you can leave this page, and start them again later.

embeddings.title: Re-embed the documents
embeddings.hint: Computes the vectors that similarity search, smart filing and the learned classifier rely on. By default only the documents that have no vector are processed: after an upload whose embedding failed, or after the vector store was reset for a change of embedding model.

insights.title: Re-enrich the documents
insights.hint: Asks the model again for the kind, summary and keywords of the documents that have no current insight. With every document, all of them are enriched again, which spends tokens.
